oracleRisk.summary: USDso has no external price feed and no borrower-liquidation branch. The verified BrandedCustodian is an ERC-4626-style peg-stability module that mints and redeems the branded token against local frxUSD at a fixed decimal ratio: _convertToAssets is a pure mulDiv of the two token decimals and pricePerShare() only re-expresses 1e18 shares, while the admin levers are mint and redeem fees, the mint cap and ERC-20 recovery. The verified GeniusDollar token exposes no feed, NAV or price selector, and the verified CrossChainRouter transports exact quantities by redeeming to frxUSD, bridging through LayerZero RemoteHopV2 and re-minting on the destination chain, with quote()/quoteSend() returning native messaging fees rather than a price. USDso therefore inherits the frxUSD parent's dollar value at a deterministic conversion ratio.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDso pricing is top-level only and has no collateral or liquidation branch: the custodian converts shares to frxUSD at a fixed decimal ratio and the router moves exact amounts. The verified token, custodian and router implementations expose no price-feed, collateral-parameter, liquidation, backstop or shutdown function; the admin levers are fees, the mint cap, RELAYER_ROLE router mapping and RemoteHopV2 replacement, which change transfer terms rather than read a price. Inherited frxUSD reserve and custodian risk remains parent, control and bridge risk, not a USDso price branch.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Twenty-one reviewed native USDso deployments mint against their local frxUSD custodians. Their exact mapped CrossChainRouters redeem USDso to frxUSD, transfer the parent through Frax RemoteHopV2/LayerZero, then deposit into the destination custodian to mint USDso. Chain-local Safes govern router beacons and router administration separately from native issuance. Complete peer, validator, role-history, limit, in-flight-liability and loss-scope inventories remain unresolved.
